opportunities.name: Cross-timezone meeting sync email
opportunities.description: Compare the time difference between city A and city B on timeanddate.com, check public holidays in city B's country, then email ops@example.com a 'Sync: A / B, <Month>' note with the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com and dismiss the cookie dialog (Deny all)
Go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Type city A in 'Add locations' and pick the first suggestion
Type city B in 'Add locations' and pick the first suggestion
Note the hour difference shown for city B
Go to Calendar > Holidays, find city B's country and open its holiday list
Note the holidays in the target month
Open New message and set To to ops@example.com
Set Subject to 'Sync: <A> / <B>, <Month>'
Set Body to '<B> is N hours ahead from <A>. Avoid: <holiday dates>.'
Send (or discard)

instances.values: New York / Berlin (Germany holidays), December; Berlin 6h ahead; avoid Dec 25 & 26; to ops@example.com
London / Sydney (Australia holidays), January; Sydney 10h ahead; avoid Jan 1 & 26; to ops@example.com

opportunities.name: Company account brief from SEC EDGAR + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a stock ticker, search the company on SEC EDGAR full-text search, filter its filings by form (e.g. 10-K) to find the latest annual report, look up HQ, employee count and CEO on Wikipedia, then email marc@example.com an 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'.
opportunities.site: efts.sec.gov EDGAR full-text search + en.wikipedia.org + webmail compose
steps: Open EDGAR full-text search
Type the ticker in the company/ticker field and pick the matching company from the autocomplete
Click SEARCH
Open the Form refine panel and choose 10-K (Annual report)
Note the latest 10-K filed date
Search the company on Wikipedia and open its article
Note HQ city, employee count, CEO
Open New message, set To to marc@example.com
Set Subject to 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Set Body to '<Company>: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Send (or discard)
